rows.en: (Okay, that's it for today's EX-Gear training.)
Hey, \p!
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders (bare name in both).

rows.en: Oh, yes? Sheryl?
You were flying quite well, I must say.
Oh, yeah, thanks...

It must be that EX-Gear. It's a good one.
Would you lend it to me?

Huh? That's not how it works.
Besides, what would you even do with it?

Fly, obviously!
I'm Sheryl. Of course I can fly!
Sheryl! What are you doing over there?!

Tch, you got lucky!
Next time we meet, you're lending me that.
That's an order!

(If Grace-san hadn't called out to her...
Just thinking about it is terrifying...)
(Okay, that's it for today's EX-Gear training.)
Oh, yes? Sheryl-san?
Looks like you were flying quite well.
Oh, yes, thank you...

Huh? That's not really the point.
Besides, what would you even do with it?
Sheryl! What are you doing?!

(Well, another week's over.
What should I do this weekend...)

(Oh, it's Sheryl...
Hmm, maybe I'll ask her what her plans are...)
Hey, Sheryl, got a minute?

What is it, \p?
Do you need something from me?

Well, I was just wondering how you're
spending this weekend, Sheryl...

Huh?!
What? Checking my schedule...
Are you asking me out on a date?
No, that's not what I...

Too bad. I've already booked the gym this weekend,
and I have to go to the beauty salon too...
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders. esute = beauty salon.

rows.en:
If you're asking me out, I'd like you to ask
sooner. Then I'd have time to think it over...
Though whether I'd say yes is another story.

Oh, look at the time!
See you!

(I think she got the wrong idea...
But maybe she wouldn't totally mind
being asked out on a date...)

(Okay, another week's over.
What should I do this weekend...)

(Oh, it's Sheryl-san...
Okay! I'll ask her what her plans are...)
Sheryl-san, do you have a minute?

What is it, \p-chan?
Do you need something from me?

Well, I was just wondering how you'll be
spending this weekend, Sheryl-san...

Huh?!
What? Checking my schedule...
Could you be asking me out on a date?
Huh?! A date...?

If you're asking me out, I'd like you to ask
sooner. Then I'd have time to think it over...

(Did she get the wrong idea...?
But maybe Sheryl-san's surprisingly easygoing...)

(P.E.'s next, huh...
It's kind of rough right after lunch.)

(Huh? Sheryl?!
Oh right, next is a joint class with the girls.)

And just what are you ogling
with those dirty eyes?
rows.notes: Sheryl, male. iyarashii me, full strength.

rows.en:
Huh?! Sheryl?
No, I wasn't looking at you like that...
You don't have to hide it. It can't be helped.
Like I said, I wasn't looking like that...

Well, whatever.
Just be careful you don't get hurt
while you're busy admiring me.

(Then again, I might end up staring
without meaning to...)

(P.E.'s next, huh...
It might be kind of rough right after lunch.)

(Huh? Sheryl-san?!
She's doing P.E. too... Well, of course she is!)
What's the matter? You look puzzled...

Huh?! Sheryl-san?
No, I wasn't making any face...

Well, whatever.
By the way, what are we doing in P.E. today?
Um... Running, together with the boys.

Oh, that's a bit dull...
Maybe I'll go back to the classroom
and sit this one out today.
rows.notes: Sheryl, female. kengaku in P.E. = sitting out and watching.

rows.en: (Sheryl-san really does whatever she likes...)
(Well, I came out into town, but what should I do...)
Huh?! Sheryl?

What's with that face? You just happened
to run into me, of all people...
No, I was just a little surprised...

Well, of course. Running into me out of the blue
in the middle of town!
So what were you doing here, anyway?

Oh, right. I had some free time, so I thought
I'd try a sweets shop a girl in my class told me
about the other day, but then, well...
rows.notes: Sheryl, both genders. Trails off (she got lost).

rows.en: Don't tell me... you're lost...

Ugh!! Oh, shut up!
Just take me there already!
That's an order!
Okay, okay.

(And so, unexpectedly, I got to enjoy the finest
sweets with Sheryl. They were delicious~)
(Okay, I came out into town, but what should I do...)
Huh?! Sheryl-san?
What's with that face? Is something wrong?

Well, of course. Running into each other
by chance in the middle of town.
So what were you doing here, anyway?
Don't tell me... you're... lost...?

Ugh!! Never mind that!
Just take me there already!
Okaaay, roger that!

(And so, unexpectedly, I got to enjoy the finest
sweets with Sheryl-san. They were delicious~)
